# Diagnostic codes: display area

Codes `DISPLAY-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/display/` (owner: VIEWER,
`openspec/changes/m1-core-viewer/design.md` D2/D3). Conventions and the
renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/display/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=display
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=display`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DISPLAY-CMAP-001` | error | A color map file (`T.C.M.cmap` or `.cmap1`) cannot be found or read. |
| `DISPLAY-CMAP-002` | error | A color map line is not `red green blue maxIndex [name]`; the load fails. |
| `DISPLAY-CMAP-003` | error | Color map entries are out of order (a maxIndex below the next index to fill). |
| `DISPLAY-CMAP-004` | error | The color map ends before every index is filled. |
| `DISPLAY-CMAP-005` | error | The color map file cannot be written. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-001` | error | No display-style file `T.D.dstyle` (or `.dstyle5`) was found. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-002` | warning | The dstyle `version` line has no number; version 6 is assumed. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-003` | error | Dstyle sections are out of order; the file is rejected. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-004` | warning | An integer in section-header position (an unexpected empty line); the line is read as data. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-005` | error | Unknown dstyle section name; the file is rejected. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-006` | error | A dstyle style or stipple line has a format error; the file is rejected. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-007` | warning | The dstyle file does not define exactly 52 internal styles (rejects the file with magic-compat off). |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-008` | error | A required dstyle section (display_styles, layout_styles, pale_styles) is missing. |
| `DISPLAY-DSTYLE-009` | error | The numbers of pale and layout styles differ; the file is rejected. |
| `DISPLAY-FONT-001` | error | An outline font file cannot be found or read. |
| `DISPLAY-FONT-002` | error | An outline font file has no glyph dictionary (`CharProcs begin`). |
| `DISPLAY-GLYPH-001` | error | A cursor glyph file cannot be found or read. |
| `DISPLAY-GLYPH-002` | error | A glyph file has a format error (no size line, a white-space cell or a short row). |
| `DISPLAY-GLYPH-003` | error | A glyph file ends before its last glyph is complete. |
| `DISPLAY-GLYPH-004` | warning | A glyph file has extra lines after its last glyph; they are ignored. |
| `DISPLAY-GLYPH-005` | error | A glyph file's size line declares more pixels (count x width x height) than the 4 Mi limit; nothing is allocated. |
| `DISPLAY-STYLE-001` | warning | A technology styles reference matches no layout style; the reference is skipped. |
| `DISPLAY-STYLE-002` | error | The technology names no styletype family, so no display styles can be loaded. |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
